episodes.title: Sick Puppy
episodes.summary: Reclusive author Aggie Wiggs' life is upended by the arrival of wealthy, arrogant new neighbor Nile Jarvis — who quite possibly murdered his first wife.

episodes.title: Just Don't Want to Be Lonely
episodes.summary: Still reeling from shock over the news, Aggie shares her suspicions with Brian and approaches Nile with an intriguing proposal.

episodes.title: Elephant in the Room
episodes.summary: As Aggie delves deeper into Nile's past, she pushes Brian to use the information she's getting. Nina takes an interest in Shelley's work.

episodes.title: Thanatos
episodes.summary: Aggie interviews Madison's parents about her disappearance. Nile and Martin take aim at the City Council. Brian enlists help to crack the hard drive.

episodes.title: Bacchanal
episodes.summary: Nile and Aggie cross boundaries with a drunken heart-to-heart, rousing Nina's suspicions. Martin and Rick conspire to make waves at Olivia's rally.

episodes.title: The Beast and Me
episodes.summary: Anxious to share her latest discovery with Brian, Aggie unexpectedly uncovers an even darker truth. Nina receives surprising news.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.summary: In 2019, a complex web of suspicion and betrayal forms between the Jarvises, Nina and Brian, and the truth behind Madison's disappearance is revealed.

episodes.title: The Last Word
episodes.summary: Backed into a corner, Aggie must use all her wits to keep her world from crashing down — and place all her trust in an unlikely ally.
